gbm_population_evidence.quote: High Grade Glioma; Glioma; Glioma, Malignant; Glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: Eligible participants will be administered a single infusion of temsirolimus through super-selective intra-arterial infusion or intravenous infusion.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: participants with a confirmed diagnosed recurrent high-grade glioma (grade 3 or 4 per WHO criteria)

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Tumor pharmacokinetics (PK) of temsirolimus: Total and unbound temsirolimus concentration in tumor tissue.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Pharmacodynamic effects of temsirolimus: Quantification of the % of pS6 positive cells

role_evidence.quote: Single infusion of Temsirolimus via super-selective intra-arterial infusion or IV

source_quote.quote: Tissue must demonstrate mTOR+: PTEN loss OR PIK3C2B or AKT3 amplification on aCGH OR mutations for PIK3CA or PIK3R1, or mTOR or PTEN mutations using next-generation sequencing analysis OR pS6 positivity on immunohistochemistry (≥30% for pS6).

biomarkers.biomarker_other: pS6 positivity by immunohistochemistry (mTOR pathway activation)

source_quote.quote: Tissue must demonstrate mTOR+: PTEN loss OR PIK3C2B or AKT3 amplification on aCGH OR mutations for PIK3CA or PIK3R1, or mTOR or PTEN mutations using next-generation sequencing analysis OR pS6 positivity on immunohistochemistry (≥30% for pS6).
Pharmacodynamic effects of temsirolimus: Quantification of the % of pS6 positive cells

coder_notes: Registered as EARLY_PHASE1 (Phase 0). Eligibility requires an 'mTOR+' tumour (any one of PTEN loss, PIK3C2B/AKT3 amplification, PIK3CA/PIK3R1/mTOR/PTEN mutation, or pS6 positivity); coded as PTEN_PI3K plus a separate pS6 row because both are alternatives in one criterion. Intra-arterial route coded new_route; not treated as device-dependent.
